patterns.note: Asymmetric content blocks with full-bleed imagery and text often offset or occupying unequal widths, creating dynamic visual balance.
Large, bold, widely-spaced sans-serif headings create a strong visual hierarchy and modern aesthetic, contrasting with a more restrained body text.
Vibrant green (#61a229) is used as a primary accent for CTAs and key information, providing a striking contrast against a largely monochromatic palette of black, white, and grays.
The main navigation and a top announcement bar stick to the top of the viewport on scroll, while a horizontal content slider (swiper) is used for browsing related items within a section.
Sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and often feature a mix of full-bleed photography and text blocks, sometimes with solid color backgrounds.

technique_notes: A persistent header system features two distinct bars: a top announcement banner and the main navigation, both of which become sticky at the top of the viewport after initial scroll.
Content sections frequently employ a horizontal carousel (using Swiper) to display multiple related items, such as hotel rooms or shop products, allowing users to browse without navigating away.

Visual hierarchy is established through the use of oversized, bold sans-serif typography for headings, paired with a more restrained, legible sans-serif for body text, creating a modern and editorial feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, widely-spaced sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounding on elements like buttons, cards, or images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; sections feature generous vertical padding, and content within sections maintains a balanced rhythm.

standout: The distinctive use of a vibrant, almost neon green as a primary accent color, combined with sophisticated, wide sans-serif typography for headings, gives the site a unique blend of modern minimalism and playful boldness. The asymmetric layouts and full-bleed imagery also contribute to an editorial, art-gallery feel, making it stand out from typical hotel sites.
